summary: Backend-only deep coverage for iteration 35 (case-insensitive login, simple non-@ login ids, per-school parent-login kill switch, staff role regression, school-create + duplicate-id rules, parent-email-to-teacher collision and parent reuse). 25/25 pytest tests passed against the live preview backend + MongoDB.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py login() lowercases email before brute-force lookup AND before user lookup — good. Brute-force identifier is `ip:email_lower` so case-variants no longer evade the lockout.
schools.py PATCH /parent-login is platform_admin only; GET is visible to platform_admin OR the school's own school_admin (intentional, matches PRD).
students.py blocks reusing a non-parent user's login id (incl. teacher) AND a parent from another school — both verified.
users.py duplicate detection uses the lowercased email so case-variants are caught — verified.
Recommendation (non-blocking): consider adding a Mongo unique index on users.email so duplicate inserts are caught even under race conditions. Today the duplicate check is read-then-write.
test_credentials: Platform admin / school admin / teacher / parent / accounts — as listed in /app/memory/test_credentials.md (used as-is, no changes).
seed_data_creation: Tests create resources tagged with TEST_ prefix + a 6-char run id: one teacher with simple id, one teacher used for collision check, two students with TEST_ parent, two staff (bus_driver + sports_coach), and one extra school with TEST code. Cleanup step (`test_zz_cleanup`) soft-deletes the TEST_-named users and staff and re-enables parent login. The TEST school itself is left behind (no delete endpoint exposed) — main agent can ignore or wipe via Mongo.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `pytest backend/tests/test_iter35_login_parent_toggle.py -v` from /app to regress all 25 cases. Each run uses a fresh uuid suffix so reruns won't collide. The test relies on the seeded DEMO school (code='DEMO', principal@sunrise.edu). If parent-login left disabled by a failed run, the cleanup step re-enables it; if even that fails, hit PATCH /api/schools/{demo_id}/parent-login {enabled:true} as platform_admin.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. All review-request features behave as specified.
